title: Introduce invocation signal aggregator and latency explainers
author: Priya Nair
body:
Summary:
This change adds an invocation-level signal aggregator and a set of latency explainers to improve root-cause analysis for long-tail latency and cost spikes. The aggregator coalesces OTel spans/metrics by a compact invocation fingerprint, emits phase-level counters (parse -> encode -> model -> postprocess), and computes a fuzzy latency fingerprint used by the UI to surface similar slow invocations. Additionally, we introduce an SLO age-adjuster that temporarily dampens alerts for newly-created routes or recently-deployed model versions to reduce noisy alerting during rollout windows.

Motivation and context:
We see a persistent class of noisy alerts triggered by transient rollout/regression windows and from variability in prompt-shape-heavy workloads. Debugging requires stitching traces, cost accounting, and prompt-shape context manually. This PR provides three complementary observability primitives: a compact invocation-signal aggregator (lower cardinality index for joins), deterministic phase counters for per-invocation phase attribution, and a latency explainer that maps a slow invocation to historical clusters for faster analysis. Linked Linear tasks: ENG-4782 (signal aggregator) and ENG-4890 (SLO-adjuster). Support ticket SUP-7821 motivated the SLO dampening behavior.

What changed (high level):
- telemetry/aggregator/invocation_aggregator.go: new pipeline that consumes OTel spans and metric events, computes a 64-bit invocation fingerprint, and writes compact signals to the signal-store; includes adaptive rollup logic to limit per-tenant cardinality.
- telemetry/metrics/phase_counters.proto & phase_counters_exporter.go: introduces per-invocation phase counters (parse_ms, encode_ms, model_ms, post_ms) emitted as OTel metrics with invocation_fingerprint label.
- telemetry/tracing/latency_explainer.go: lightweight k-NN index over hashed prompt-shape vectors and phase distributions to find historically similar slow invocations; returns an explanation score and example invocation IDs.
- dashboards/grafana/invocation-signal-panel.json: new Grafana panel that surfaces the explainer results, sample invocations, and per-phase stacked latency breakdown.
- alerts/slo_age_adjuster.yaml: controller that adjusts SLO alerting thresholds for routes/models in their first 24h (configurable via remote-config).
- internal/featureflags/ff_evaluate.go: feature flag gating for the SLO dampening (ff.observability.slo_age_adjust).
- tests/integration/observability_test.go: new integration tests that validate aggregation correctness and SLO adjuster behavior under simulated rollout traffic.
- docs/observability/README.md: user-facing notes on new metric names and how to use the latency explainer in the Console.

Commits (summary):
- Add invocation fingerprint and compact signal schema (priyaa/collector)
- Emit per-phase counters in telemetry pipeline (priyaa/metrics)
- Implement latency explainer service and k-NN index (priyaa/explainer)
- Dashboard and alert rules for SLO age adjuster (priyaa/grafana & priyaa/alerts)
- Tests and docs (priyaa/tests/docs)

Files touched (representative):
telemetry/aggregator/invocation_aggregator.go
telemetry/metrics/phase_counters.proto
telemetry/metrics/phase_counters_exporter.go
telemetry/tracing/latency_explainer.go
dashboards/grafana/invocation-signal-panel.json
alerts/slo_age_adjuster.yaml
internal/featureflags/ff_evaluate.go
tests/integration/observability_test.go
docs/observability/README.md
Makefile (tweak to include explainer build)

Compatibility and stability:
- Backwards compatible: existing metrics remain unchanged. We add new metric names with the prefix invocation_phase_ and a new label invocation_fingerprint. Downstream consumers that filter by metric name will not be affected unless they explicitly opt into the new labels.
- The SLO age adjuster is disabled by default; enable via remote-config or the Console toggle. Rollout is staged: feature flag -> 10% tenants -> 100% after monitoring.

Testing and CI:
- Added unit tests for fingerprint determinism and phase attribution.
- Integration test simulates 10k invocations of mixed prompt shapes; verifies aggregator cardinality bounds and that the explainer returns consistent clusters for repeated slow invocations.
- CI run: initial pipeline failed on lint (unused variable in latency_explainer.go), fix pushed, second run: all checks passed (lint, unit, integration, e2e-sim). Final CI status: pass.

Performance and cost impact:
- Extra telemetry emission increases metric cardinality modestly for tenants that opt in. The aggregator applies adaptive rollups; in benchmarks (locally) we see ~2.4% CPU increase for the ingest pipeline under steady load and an additional ~20MB/s memory transient during k-NN index rebuilds.
- Storage: compact signals are 8-12 bytes per invocation plus small metadata; we expect <1% storage cost increase for typical tenants due to rollups.

Rollout plan:
- Feature is behind ff.observability.invocation_signal (off by default).
- Canary to 5 tenants for 48h, monitor ingest CPU, explainer latency (95th), and alert churn.
- If stable, open rollout to tiered expansion (20% -> 100%).

Release notes (for users):
- New telemetry: invocation_phase_parse_ms, invocation_phase_encode_ms, invocation_phase_model_ms, invocation_phase_post_ms (labels: route, model, invocation_fingerprint).
- Console: new 'Invocation Signal' panel (Observability -> Invocations) with latency explainers to surface similar historical slow invocations.
- SLOs: new SLO age adjuster can be enabled to reduce noisy alerts during route/version rollout windows.

Review conversation (high level):
- Evan Collins: "Nice work on the fingerprinting approach; how deterministic is the fingerprint across SDK versions?"
  - Priya: "Fingerprint is computed from stable attributes (route + model_version + ordered token-shape sketch); SDK changes that only reorder non-stable fields are guarded by a versioned hash salt. Added tests to validate determinism across synthetic SDK versions."
- Lena García: "We need to ensure the explainer doesn't leak PII via example prompts exposed in the UI."
  - Priya: "Explainer returns tokenized shapes and a redacted prompt snippet. UI will enforce redact rules; added server-side redaction to the aggregator pipeline as a safeguard."
- Marcus Lee: "Alert dampening window sounds useful, but could mask real regressions during rollout."
  - Priya: "We added a safety override: if error rate or cost per-token deviates >X% concurrently with latency, the adjuster will not dampen alerts. Configurable via remote-config."
- Evan Collins (approval): "LGTM after addressing lint and adding the redaction tests."

Merging and follow-ups:
- Merge method: squash.
- Follow-up tickets created: ENG-5012 (optimize k-NN rebuild), ENG-5023 (add Console drilldown for explainer examples), ENG-5024 (metric retention policy for invocation signals).

Notes for operators:
- To enable for a tenant: flip ff.observability.invocation_signal -> true and optionally ff.observability.slo_age_adjust -> true.
- Monitor metric telemetry.aggregator.backpressure and explainer.rebuild.duration during rollout.

Acknowledgements:
Thanks to Evan for design feedback, Lena for security review, and Platform SRE (Marcus) for perf guidance.
